series.name: Chairside Atlas
series.tagline: The Comprehensive Adult Eye Exam, Step by Step
series.description: A 15-episode walkthrough of every step an optometrist performs during a comprehensive adult eye examination — from history to final prescription — with clinical decision-making at each station.

series.name: Refraction Mastery
series.tagline: Advanced Refraction Techniques for the Optometrist
series.description: A 15-episode deep dive into the art and science of refraction — retinoscopy, cross cylinder, cycloplegia, and the difficult refractions that separate competent optometrists from great ones.

series.name: Glaucoma Guardian
series.tagline: Diagnosis, Monitoring, and Management of Glaucoma
series.description: A 15-episode series covering every clinical decision point in glaucoma care — from IOP and gonioscopy through OCT and visual fields to first-line therapy and surgical referral.

series.name: Retina Revealed
series.tagline: Medical Retina for the Optometrist
series.description: A 15-episode series covering the medical retina conditions optometrists encounter most — diabetic retinopathy, AMD, vein occlusions, and the OCT signs that drive referral decisions.

series.name: Cornea Confidential
series.tagline: Corneal Disease and External Eye for the Optometrist
series.description: A 15-episode series on corneal pathology — keratoconus, dystrophies, infections, and the slit lamp and topography signs that guide management.

series.name: Dry Eye Decoder
series.tagline: Modern Dry Eye Diagnosis and Practice Building
series.description: A 15-episode series covering the full dry eye spectrum — meibomian gland dysfunction, aqueous deficiency, in-office treatments, and building a dry eye service line.

series.name: Contact Lens Clinic
series.tagline: Fitting and Managing Contact Lens Patients
series.description: A 15-episode series on contact lens practice — soft and GP fitting, multifocal and scleral lenses, orthokeratology, and the complications every optometrist must recognise.

series.name: Pediatric Perspectives
series.tagline: Eye Care for Children from Infancy to Adolescence
series.description: A 15-episode series on pediatric optometry — visual development, amblyopia, strabismus, myopia control, and the conditions that demand early intervention.

series.name: Neuro Navigator
series.tagline: Neuro-Ophthalmology for the Optometrist
series.description: A 15-episode series on neuro-ophthalmology — optic neuritis, cranial nerve palsies, papilloedema, and the vision changes that signal serious neurologic disease.

series.name: Anterior Atlas
series.tagline: Anterior Segment and External Eye Disease
series.description: A 15-episode series covering the conjunctiva, sclera, eyelids, and lacrimal system — the everyday anterior segment conditions optometrists manage.

series.name: Pharmacology Focus
series.tagline: Ocular and Systemic Pharmacology for Optometrists
series.description: A 15-episode series on the drugs optometrists prescribe and the systemic drugs that affect the eye — from mydriatics to hydroxychloroquine screening.

series.name: Low Vision Lens
series.tagline: Low Vision Rehabilitation and Visual Aids
series.description: A 15-episode series on low vision care — assessment, magnification theory, optical and electronic aids, and the rehabilitation strategies for each cause of vision loss.

series.name: Vision Therapy Vault
series.tagline: Binocular Vision Disorders and Orthoptic Therapy
series.description: A 15-episode series on binocular vision and vision therapy — from convergence insufficiency through accommodative and ocular motor dysfunction to amblyopia treatment protocols.

series.name: Practice Pulse
series.tagline: Practice Management and Professional Issues in Optometry
series.description: A 15-episode series on the business and ethics of optometry — communication, coding, compliance, and building a sustainable practice that serves patients well.

series.name: Refractive Surgery Review
series.tagline: Co-Managing LASIK, PRK, SMILE, and IOL Refractive Procedures
series.description: A 15-episode series on refractive surgery — patient selection, the procedures, complications, and the optometrist's role in co-management.

series.name: Urgent Eye
series.tagline: Ocular Emergencies and Urgent Presentations
series.description: A 15-episode series on the ocular emergencies that walk into optometry practice — from the red eye and sudden vision loss to chemical burns and open globes.

series.name: Systemic Signs
series.tagline: Systemic Disease and the Eye
series.description: A 15-episode series on the ocular manifestations of systemic disease — diabetes, hypertension, thyroid disease, and the eye signs that prompt a medical workup.

series.name: Tech & Imaging
series.tagline: Diagnostic Technology and Imaging Interpretation
series.description: A 15-episode series on the technology that powers modern optometry — OCT, visual fields, topography, and the interpretation skills every optometrist needs.

series.name: Lens & Cataract
series.tagline: Cataract Diagnosis, Pre-Op, and Co-Management
series.description: A 15-episode series on the crystalline lens — cataract types, pre-operative assessment, IOL selection, and the post-operative care that optometrists provide.

series.name: Prescribing Pearls
series.tagline: The Art and Science of the Spectacle Prescription
series.description: A 15-episode series on spectacle prescribing — from the final Rx to lens materials, prism, tints, and the special prescriptions for computer, sports, and low vision.
